entries.name: Back Squat
entries.notes: Brace before you unrack. Sit between the hips, knees tracking over the toes.

entries.name: Front Squat
entries.notes: Elbows high throughout. The bar sits on the shelf of the shoulders, not the hands.

entries.name: Box Squat
entries.notes: Sit back to the box, pause without relaxing, drive up.

entries.name: Pause Squat
entries.notes: Two seconds at the bottom, staying tight. No bounce.

entries.name: Overhead Squat
entries.notes: Bar over the mid-foot, arms locked. Mobility first, load second.

entries.name: Zercher Squat
entries.notes: Bar in the crook of the elbows. Keep the chest up.

entries.name: Hack Squat
entries.notes: Feet mid-platform. Control the descent.

entries.name: Goblet Squat
entries.notes: Elbows inside the knees at the bottom. Good first squat.

entries.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
entries.notes: Rear foot elevated. Most of the weight through the front heel.

entries.name: Walking Lunge
entries.notes: Step long enough that the front shin stays near vertical.

entries.name: Reverse Lunge
entries.notes: Kinder on the knees than the forward version.

entries.name: Step Up
entries.notes: Drive through the top foot. Don't push off the floor.

entries.name: Leg Press
entries.notes: Stop before the lower back rounds off the pad.

entries.name: Leg Extension
entries.notes: Pause at the top. Slow on the way down.

entries.name: Sissy Squat
entries.notes: Knees travel forward, hips stay extended.

entries.name: Deadlift
entries.notes: Bar over mid-foot, lats engaged, push the floor away.

entries.name: Sumo Deadlift
entries.notes: Wide stance, hands inside the knees. Open the hips on the way up.

entries.name: Romanian Deadlift
entries.notes: Hinge, don't squat. Bar stays in contact with the legs.

entries.name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
entries.notes: Soft knees, long spine. Stop where the back would round.

entries.name: Deficit Deadlift
entries.notes: Stand on a plate. More range, less load.

entries.name: Rack Pull
entries.notes: Set the pins at or just below the knee.

entries.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
entries.notes: More upright than a straight bar. Good for volume.

entries.name: Good Morning
entries.notes: Light. Hinge until the hamstrings say stop.

entries.name: Hip Thrust
entries.notes: Chin tucked, ribs down. Pause at lockout.

entries.name: Glute Bridge
entries.notes: Squeeze at the top rather than arching the back.

entries.name: Nordic Curl
entries.notes: Lower as slowly as you can control. Brutal, effective.

entries.name: Lying Leg Curl
entries.notes: Hips down. Don't let them rise to help.

entries.name: Seated Leg Curl
entries.notes: Slight forward lean lengthens the hamstring.

entries.name: Back Extension
entries.notes: Extend the hips, not the spine.

entries.name: Reverse Hyperextension
entries.notes: Control the swing. It is not a pendulum.

entries.name: Bench Press
entries.notes: Shoulder blades tucked and down. Bar to the lower chest.

entries.name: Incline Bench Press
entries.notes: Thirty degrees is plenty. Higher turns it into a press.

entries.name: Decline Bench Press
entries.notes: Shorter range, heavier loads. Watch the shoulders.

entries.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
entries.notes: Shoulder-width grip. Elbows tucked.

entries.name: Floor Press
entries.notes: Pause when the elbows touch down. No leg drive.

entries.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
entries.notes: More range than the bar, and each side works alone.

entries.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
entries.notes: Let the hands rotate naturally at the top.

entries.name: Dumbbell Fly
entries.notes: Slight elbow bend, held. Stretch, don't sink.

entries.name: Cable Fly
entries.notes: Constant tension. Cross slightly at the top.

entries.name: Machine Chest Press
entries.notes: Seat height so the handles line up with the mid-chest.

entries.name: Push-Up
entries.notes: Body in one line. Elbows at about forty-five degrees.

entries.name: Dip
entries.notes: Lean forward for chest, stay upright for triceps.

entries.name: Pec Deck
entries.notes: Elbows in line with the shoulders.

entries.name: Overhead Press
entries.notes: Squeeze the glutes. Move the head back, then through.

entries.name: Push Press
entries.notes: Short dip, hard drive. The legs start it, the arms finish it.

entries.name: Seated Dumbbell Press
entries.notes: Back supported. Press slightly in front of the ears.

entries.name: Arnold Press
entries.notes: Rotate as you press. Light weight, deliberate.

entries.name: Lateral Raise
entries.notes: Lead with the elbows. Stop at shoulder height.

entries.name: Cable Lateral Raise
entries.notes: Tension at the bottom, which the dumbbell version lacks.

entries.name: Front Raise
entries.notes: No swing. Thumbs slightly up.

entries.name: Rear Delt Fly
entries.notes: Chest supported. Think about pulling the elbows apart.

entries.name: Face Pull
entries.notes: Rope to the forehead, elbows high. Everyone needs more of these.

entries.name: Upright Row
entries.notes: Wide grip, stop at chest height, or skip it if the shoulders complain.

entries.name: Landmine Press
entries.notes: Kind to shoulders that dislike overhead work.

entries.name: Handstand Push-Up
entries.notes: Against a wall until the balance is there.

entries.name: Pull-Up
entries.notes: Start from a dead hang. Chest to the bar.

entries.name: Chin-Up
entries.notes: Supinated grip. More biceps than the pull-up.

entries.name: Lat Pulldown
entries.notes: Pull the elbows down and back, not the hands.

entries.name: Barbell Row
entries.notes: Torso about forty-five degrees. Bar to the navel.

entries.name: Pendlay Row
entries.notes: Bar rests on the floor each rep. Explosive.

entries.name: Dumbbell Row
entries.notes: One hand braced. Don't rotate the torso to lift more.

entries.name: Chest-Supported Row
entries.notes: Removes the lower back from the equation.

entries.name: Seated Cable Row
entries.notes: Sit tall. Small squeeze at the end, no rocking.

entries.name: T-Bar Row
entries.notes: Neutral grip. Chest against the pad if there is one.

entries.name: Inverted Row
entries.notes: Adjust difficulty by walking the feet out.

entries.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
entries.notes: Lats only. Arms stay long.

entries.name: Shrug
entries.notes: Straight up. Rolling the shoulders adds nothing.

entries.name: Farmer's Carry
entries.notes: Tall posture, small steps. Grip gives out first.

entries.name: Rack Chin
entries.notes: Feet on a bench. A good bridge to full pull-ups.

entries.name: Barbell Curl
entries.notes: Elbows pinned to the ribs. No swing.

entries.name: Dumbbell Curl
entries.notes: Supinate as you lift.

entries.name: Hammer Curl
entries.notes: Neutral grip. Hits the brachialis.

entries.name: Preacher Curl
entries.notes: No bounce out of the bottom.

entries.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
entries.notes: Arms behind the body puts the long head on stretch.

entries.name: Cable Curl
entries.notes: Tension all the way through.

entries.name: Concentration Curl
entries.notes: Elbow braced on the thigh. Slow.

entries.name: Triceps Pushdown
entries.notes: Elbows still. Full lockout.

entries.name: Overhead Triceps Extension
entries.notes: Puts the long head on stretch.

entries.name: Skull Crusher
entries.notes: Lower to the forehead or just behind it.

entries.name: Triceps Kickback
entries.notes: Upper arm parallel to the floor and still.

entries.name: Wrist Curl
entries.notes: Small range, high reps.

entries.name: Reverse Curl
entries.notes: Pronated grip. Go lighter than you think.

entries.name: Dead Hang
entries.notes: Timed, not counted. Shoulders active.

entries.name: Plank
entries.notes: Ribs down, glutes on. Timed.

entries.name: Side Plank
entries.notes: Hips stacked and lifted. Timed.

entries.name: Hanging Leg Raise
entries.notes: Curl the pelvis. Don't just swing the legs.

entries.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
entries.notes: Go only as far as the back stays flat.

entries.name: Cable Crunch
entries.notes: Flex the spine. Hips stay put.

entries.name: Dead Bug
entries.notes: Lower back pressed down throughout.

entries.name: Bird Dog
entries.notes: Slow. No rotation through the hips.

entries.name: Pallof Press
entries.notes: Resist the rotation. That is the whole exercise.

entries.name: Russian Twist
entries.notes: Rotate through the ribs, not the arms.

entries.name: Hollow Hold
entries.notes: Lower back glued to the floor. Timed.

entries.name: Suitcase Carry
entries.notes: One side loaded. Don't lean.

entries.name: Copenhagen Plank
entries.notes: Adductors. Start with the knee supported.

entries.name: Power Clean
entries.notes: Patience off the floor, then violent extension.

entries.name: Hang Clean
entries.notes: From the hip. Good for learning the second pull.

entries.name: Clean and Jerk
entries.notes: Two lifts. Practise them apart before joining them.

entries.name: Snatch
entries.notes: Wide grip, bar close. Technique before load, always.

entries.name: Power Snatch
entries.notes: Catch above parallel.

entries.name: Clean Pull
entries.notes: Full extension, no catch.

entries.name: Push Jerk
entries.notes: Dip, drive, punch under.

entries.name: Split Jerk
entries.notes: Front shin vertical, back knee soft.

entries.name: Kettlebell Swing
entries.notes: A hinge, not a squat. The arms are rope.

entries.name: Kettlebell Snatch
entries.notes: Punch through at the top so it doesn't bang the wrist.

entries.name: Turkish Get-Up
entries.notes: Eyes on the bell until standing. Slow is the point.

entries.name: Kettlebell Goblet Carry
entries.notes: Ribs down. Timed or by distance.

entries.name: Barbell Calf Raise
entries.notes: Pause at the top and the bottom.

entries.name: Standing Calf Raise
entries.notes: Full stretch at the bottom.

entries.name: Seated Calf Raise
entries.notes: Bent knee shifts the work to the soleus.

entries.name: Tibialis Raise
entries.notes: Underrated. Helps the knees.

entries.name: Treadmill Run
entries.notes: Logged by distance or time.

entries.name: Outdoor Run
entries.notes: Logged by distance.

entries.name: Interval Run
entries.notes: Work and rest, repeated. Log total distance.

entries.name: Rowing Machine
entries.notes: Legs, then back, then arms. Reverse on the return.

entries.name: Assault Bike
entries.notes: Short and horrible, or long and steady.

entries.name: Stationary Bike
entries.notes: Steady state or intervals.

entries.name: Stair Climber
entries.notes: Don't lean on the handles.

entries.name: Swim
entries.notes: Logged by distance.

entries.name: Ski Erg
entries.notes: Hinge and pull. Mostly lats.

entries.name: Jump Rope
entries.notes: Small jumps. Wrists do the work.

entries.name: Sled Push
entries.notes: Low body angle, short steps.

entries.name: Sled Drag
entries.notes: Backwards drags are kind to the knees.

entries.name: Box Jump
entries.notes: Step down, always. Jumping down adds risk and nothing else.

entries.name: Broad Jump
entries.notes: Land soft. Quality over quantity.

entries.name: Medicine Ball Slam
entries.notes: Whole body. Follow through.

entries.name: Sprint
entries.notes: Warm up properly first.

entries.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
entries.notes: Squeeze the glute of the back leg. Timed.

entries.name: 90/90 Hip Switch
entries.notes: Slow, controlled rotations.

entries.name: Couch Stretch
entries.notes: Tuck the pelvis before leaning back. Timed.

entries.name: Pigeon Pose
entries.notes: Square the hips. Breathe.

entries.name: Thoracic Extension
entries.notes: Foam roller under the upper back. Ribs down.

entries.name: Cat-Cow
entries.notes: Move one vertebra at a time.

entries.name: Shoulder Dislocate
entries.notes: Band or broomstick. Widen the grip if it pinches.

entries.name: Wall Slide
entries.notes: Ribs down, forearms on the wall.

entries.name: Ankle Dorsiflexion
entries.notes: Knee over the toe, heel down. Timed.

entries.name: Hamstring Floss
entries.notes: Nerve glide, not a stretch. Gentle.

entries.name: Deep Squat Hold
entries.notes: Sit in it. Timed.

entries.name: Child's Pose
entries.notes: Reach long. Timed.

entries.name: Downward Dog
entries.notes: Pedal the heels.

entries.name: Thread the Needle
entries.notes: Thoracic rotation. Slow.

entries.name: Neck CARs
entries.notes: Controlled articular rotations. Small and honest.

entries.name: Wrist Mobility
entries.notes: Load the wrists gently in every direction.

entries.name: Bodyweight
entries.notes: Same time of day, same conditions.

entries.name: Waist
entries.notes: At the navel, relaxed.

entries.name: Chest Measurement
entries.notes: At the nipple line, arms down.

entries.name: Hips
entries.notes: At the widest point.

entries.name: Thigh
entries.notes: Mid-thigh, same side each time.

entries.name: Arm
entries.notes: Mid-bicep, relaxed or flexed, but be consistent.

entries.name: Resting Heart Rate
entries.notes: First thing, before getting up.

entries.name: Sleep Duration
entries.notes: Hours, however you measure them.

entries.name: Body Fat
entries.notes: Same method every time, or the trend means nothing.
